title: Equipment Handoff Authorization Form
subtitle: Equipment Handoff: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Equipment Handoff Authorization Form controls equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation by tying each Equipment Handoff custody, document, or movement decision to the equipment owner / custodian, a stated boundary, and an expiry. The equipment custody coordinator preserves conditions, exceptions, confirmation, and both sides of the handoff.
use_case: Use Equipment Handoff Authorization Form at issuing location, receiving location, transport path, and return point. Check applicable Equipment Handoff requirements, list the affected quantity, value, document, route, or custody action, and state its limit. Record whether the equipment owner / custodian approves, conditions, holds, or declines the request; obtain renewed consent before changing equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation scope.

sections.title: Decision context and authorization record
sections.guidance: For Equipment Handoff, identify responsible parties, issuing location, receiving location, transport path, and return point, and the linked equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation source.

fields.label: Asset tag, serial, model, and quantity
Accessory, key, credential, software, and configuration identifiers

sections.title: Authorization basis and bounded decision
sections.guidance: Capture Equipment Handoff facts for equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Equipment Handoff authorization checks
items: Custody date, location, and intended use
Return condition, due date, and unresolved defect

sections.title: Decision evidence, expiry, and next control
sections.guidance: Resolve open Equipment Handoff conditions; have equipment custody coordinator assign the next Equipment Handoff owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Decision limits, holds, and retained evidence
items: Unsafe or failed equipment cannot be released
blocks.guidance: Pause Equipment Handoff when authority, identity, condition, data protection, accessory accounting, or custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Equipment Handoff proof and route unresolved equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation scope to equipment custody coordinator.
